data.description: Your animal companion moves with astonishing agility and speed until the end of its turn. It can move at full speed while using Acrobatics, and it gains a +(min(20,CASTERLEVEL*2)) competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to avoid attacks of opportunity or move through a square occupied by an enemy.
